input clk;

  next_state = state; 
  next_data_reg = data_reg; 
  next_ready_o = 0; 
  data_o = data_reg; 
  if (state) begin 
  if (start_i) begin 
  next_state = 1; 
  end 
  end else begin 
  data_reg_var[state] = sbox_data_i;
